scope: Independent packages, default optimization, compilation only

missing-intrinsic: The parser rejects an intrinsic with no lowering implementation. Add a real CBC operation or an ABI-correct runtime call, not a constant/no-op result.
math-types: Float32/Float16 operands are passed to DoubleType/FloatType math nodes without conversion; PowI also receives an Int32 exponent where LongType is required. Normalize operands/results and fix overload selection.
float-conversion: ValueConvert(F64,F64) reaches Identities.scala:464, whose same-type identity allows signed integers/U16 only. The CHIR floating conversion path emits the redundant node. Fix the identity or avoid creating it.
callback-address: Address of a CBC-defined C callback

CHIRParser.State.valueOfFunc asserts method.isCangjieForeign. These methods take/pass/store a C function value defined in CBC, rather than an imported foreign function. Lower the CBC callback address/bridge instead of requiring an imported symbol.
generic-pointer: CPointerRead/CPointerWrite handle primitive pointees or fixed records and assert pointee.isRecord for generic T. Implement dynamic size/alignment, address calculation and generic value copy/boxing.
atomic-option: AtomicOps.irType calls ValueType(OptionLikeEnum(...T...)), which is unsupported. Normalize nullable/generic option storage to the correct atomic representation.
cast: The CHIR cast matcher has no case for the observed tuple covariance or generic-reference-to-type-variable cast. Implement representation-aware casts, not a fabricated result.
generic-dispatch: The parser cannot find the required VTable slot for pprintDifferentSizes or HandlerCase.tryHandle. Resolve extension/generic signatures and slot lookup consistently.
field-instantiation: Loading TestCaseResult's ArrayList<RunStepResult> field compares the instantiated signature with ArrayList<T0> retained in GetFieldSeqRef and asserts. Apply owner/type-argument substitution to the field reference.
generic-instanceof: InstanceOfGeneric expects a traceable reference but receives a record address (ShrinkKeyWrapper or Array<T>). Lower record/generic type tests with the appropriate boxing/type-info representation.
cstring-null: CHIR.Constant.intConst has no CString case. A null CString enters this matcher and throws MatchError; lower it as an address-valued zero.
receiver-abi: TreeMapEntryView.value setter's $withoutTI wrapper builds a key getter invocation whose receiver is LongType instead of a traceable reference. The reported mismatch is definite; the precise receiver-index/substitution correction needs a focused reproducer.
enum-return: MultilineDiffBuilder.compareByDist returns primitive enum WeakEq, but a VerificationNode replacement is not IntType as required by Return[IntType]. This identifies the failing IR invariant; the exact producer/rewrite needs a focused investigation.
